Raw traces first, then `sdh_onset` per-tone tracks and the high-B FFT against the full-density Onsager frequency F_full = |n|h/4e. Both runs completed clean (921/921 and 486/486 rows, no leak trips; sr1 at 50 µV = 5 kΩ FS, max fs 0.12).

"""Runs 6 & 7 — sdh-spot-check pair at D = 0 (run-5 calibration): raw traces, then
per-tone onsets (sdh_onset) and the SdH FFT vs the full-density Onsager frequency."""
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, current_channel, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError

FS_R = 50e-6 / 10e-9   # sr1 sens / nominal bias = 5 kOhm full scale (both runs)

def sdh_trace(rid):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = resolve_channels(r.meta); cur = current_channel(ch)
    v = [c for c in ch if c.cid == "sr1"][0]
    I = np.abs(r.col_at(cur.idx) / cur.gain)
    R = np.abs((r.col_at(v.idx) / v.gain) / I)
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], R[o], r

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for row, (rid, label, n12) in enumerate([(6, "electron, n = +3.2e12, D = 0", 3.2),
                                         (7, "hole, n = -1.2e12, D = 0", -1.2)]):
    B, R, r = sdh_trace(rid)
    F_full = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16)
    print(f"=== run {rid} ({label}) === {len(B)} pts, B {B.min():.2f}-{B.max():.2f} T; "
          f"R {R.min():.1f}-{R.max():.1f} Ohm; F_full(|n|) = {F_full:.1f} T")
    try:
        o = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=FS_R)
        print(o.summary())
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"sdh_onset failed: {e}")
    sel = B >= 1.5
    freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[sel][:, None], B[sel], nfft=4096)
    axs[row, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    axs[row, 0].set_xlabel("B (T)"); axs[row, 0].set_ylabel("|Rxx| (Ohm)")
    axs[row, 0].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — {label}")
    axs[row, 1].plot(freqs, spec[0], lw=0.8)
    axs[row, 1].axvline(F_full, color="r", ls="--", lw=1, label=f"F_full = {F_full:.1f} T")
    axs[row, 1].set_xlim(0, 60); axs[row, 1].set_xlabel("F (T)"); axs[row, 1].set_ylabel("FFT mag")
    axs[row, 1].legend(fontsize=8); axs[row, 1].set_title(f"run {rid} SdH FFT (B >= 1.5 T; dF ~ 1.8 T)")
    print()
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read (runs 6, 7):** High-quality SdH on both carrier signs — onsets ≤ 0.7 T, SNR up to ~120, no leakage (TG/BG excursions stay in the ±0.2 nA flyback band). **Electron side (run 6, n = +3.2e12, F_full = 33.1 T):** the record is carried by a light tone at **7.1 T ≈ 0.21·F_full**, oscillating from below 0.3 T; the higher tones (14.1, 22.2, 29.5 T) all sit within ~1 T of its 2×/3×/4× harmonics — at this single-point resolution (dF ≈ 1.8 T) a genuine heavy pocket near 26 T (the two-subband expectation 7.5 + 25.6 T) can't be separated from harmonic content. No tone at F_full itself. **Hole side (run 7, n = −1.2e12, F_full = 12.4 T):** multi-tone — 6.6 and 4.7 T pockets plus the strongest peak at **12.3 T ≈ F_full** (SNR 124), i.e. a full-density orbit component coexisting with small pockets, a multi-band hole Fermi surface. Above ~7.5 T (electron) / ~8 T (hole) both traces climb into a large feature (R → 530–590 Ω) — approaching the quantum limit of the light pockets. **Verdict for the arc:** both spot checks pass; the tone taxonomy (pocket fractions vs n, harmonics vs subbands, filling-factor sequence) is exactly what the Landau fan resolves — proceed to the fan over the full D = 0 window.

## HERA — Step 5: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking-call dataset

> **05:26** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.20e12 fast (201 pts, TG+BG co-swept, run-5 cal), B 0..10 T slow (0.1 T, 101 rows), sr1 200 uV, 20.3k pts, ends at 10 T · **ETA ~13:56** (≈8h30m)

**Plan step 5** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`, recreated post-handoff). Runs 6/7 (ana cells 14–17) pass the feasibility gate: SdH from ≤ 0.7 T on both carrier signs, but the spot FFTs cannot separate harmonics from genuine subband tones (electron side: 7.1 T + 2×/3×/4× content vs a real heavy pocket near 26 T; hole side: multi-band with 12.3 T ≈ F_full). The fan resolves this by slope: harmonics scale with their parent tone vs n, subbands carry their own frequency-vs-n line; and the filling-factor / LL-crossing structure fanning from the CNP gives the zero-LL degeneracy — together the ABAB / ABCA / ABCB discriminators.

**Geometry:** fast axis = n from −1.25 to +3.20×10¹² (201 pts, Δn ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰), TG+BG co-swept along the run-5 calibrated D = 0 line (`multimegasweep`, ratio 0.773, n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm); slow axis = B from 0 → 10 T in 0.1 T (101 rows, ascending from where the magnet sits, ending at the top — the next step rides it down). **Coverage:** the full validator-realizable D = 0 window minus a ~2% margin at both ends (n = ±1.27/+3.27 map to the exact TG rails); nothing physical is excluded.

**Pacing (measured, run 5):** fast_delay 1.0 s + 0.10 s/pt reads (4873 s / 63 rows / 66 pts) → 221 s/row + flyback ~4.5 s + 0.1 T ramp 44 s + 3 s settle + slow_delay 1 s ≈ 273 s/row × 101 ≈ 7.7 h; with this session's actuals running 5–10% over: **≈ 8–8.5 h**. Sensitivity 200 µV = 20 kΩ FS (run-4 lesson: size to the gapped-CNP expectation, not the B = 0 peaks); the ν = 0 ridge may still rail at high B — accepted, the rail is gap evidence.

**Checkpoints** (reading the armed `hera-watch --follow` digests): (1) first 2–3 rows — leakage, rail, dead channel, T stable; (2) row ~20 (B ≈ 2 T) — re-form the partial fan, Landau lines must resolve in n, else interrupt and re-grid; (3) row ~50 (B ≈ 5 T) — interim fan + FFT-vs-n read, continue/adjust call. Abort lever: `nb-collab interrupt` (leak trip is automatic at 1 nA; magnet keeps ramping to the row setpoint on interrupt — re-read field after any abort).

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n fast -1.25 -> +3.20e12 (201 pts, TG+BG co-swept); B slow 0 -> 10 T (0.1 T, 101 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; same CAL as runs 6/7) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.20, 201)                      # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 2.2e10
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.0, 10.0001, 0.1), 4)          # 101 rows, ascending from where the magnet sits
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"fast line: n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 -> Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}] V, "
      f"Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V; slow B {B_vec[0]}..{B_vec[-1]} T x {len(B_vec)}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not at 1"

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 1.0     # run-5 gatemap pacing (known-good at tau 0.3 s)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 200 uV = 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA —
# headroom for the nu=0 CNP ridge at high B; ~50 Ohm SdH proven clean at 0.3% FS in run 6.
# If the nu=0 ridge exceeds 20 kOhm it soft-clips on that column only — accepted (the rail is
# itself gap evidence); everything else has >30x headroom.
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f"drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (20 kOhm FS); "
      f"tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan at D = 0: fast n = -1.25..+3.20e12 (201 pts, TG+BG co-swept along run-5 D = 0 line), "
                  "slow B = 0..10 T (0.1 T, 101 rows), sr1 200 uV, Vsi = 0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: fast n -1.25..+3.20e12, 201 pts (dn 2.2e10), Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.3f},{Vtg_vec.max():+.3f}], '
              f'Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.3f},{Vbg_vec.max():+.3f}]; slow B 0..10 T, 0.1 T, 101 rows; '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; '
              f'T = {_T0:.2f} K')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0.0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0.0)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T (left at the fan top — the next step rides it down), gates parked at 0")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
